name: The Things Stack
description: Open-source LoRaWAN network server from The Things Industries for managing gateways, devices and application traffic.

envVars.description: Base64-encoded license file for production use

composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    environment:
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
      TTN_LW_IS_DATABASE_URI: "postgres://ttn_lorawan:{{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}@{{serviceName}}-postgres:5432/ttn_lorawan?sslmode=disable"
      TTN_LW_REDIS_ADDRESS: "{{serviceName}}-redis:6379"
      TTS_LICENSE: {{env.TTS_LICENSE}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/config:/config
    depends_on:
      - {{serviceName}}-postgres
      - {{serviceName}}-redis
  {{serviceName}}-postgres:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-postgres
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: ttn_lorawan
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}
      POSTGRES_DB: ttn_lorawan
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/postgres:/var/lib/postgresql/data
  {{serviceName}}-redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-redis
    restart: unless-stopped
